All 7 test cases pass. The implementation in `bottle_song.go`:

- **`numbers` slice** — spelled-out counts indexed by bottle count (`"no"`, `"one"`, … `"ten"`).
- **`Recite(startBottles, takeDown)`** — builds each verse with `fmt.Sprintf`, then joins verses with a blank line and splits on newlines to produce the `[]string` of lines the tests expect.
- **`bottle(n)`** — handles singular/plural: no `"s"` when `n == 1`, otherwise `"s"` (so "one green bottle" vs "no green bottles").
- Uses the `Title` helper from the test file (same package) to capitalize verse openings, avoiding the deprecated `strings.Title`.

No other files were touched.
